primary_source_receipts.locator: Bessembinder, "Do Stocks Outperform Treasury Bills?", SSRN abstract via web.archive.org 2019 capture; local copy SHA-256 cbea73d8ed9a412bd47ea1e3785be542deb0a19c8f6fd7a78c2c93c79bce43db
primary_source_receipts.finding: "Four out of every seven common stocks" in CRSP since 1926 have lifetime buy-and-hold returns below one-month Treasuries; "the best-performing four percent" explain the net gain for the entire US market.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Abstract only; body figures (25,967 stocks, 57.4%, 86 firms, delistings) not reinspected. Live SSRN returned HTTP 403.

primary_source_receipts.limitations: Author-hosted final version; sample is from the 1990s.
